MAJOR: `architect_review.py` EXCLUDE now drops `**/config/**` from the reviewed diff, but the new `_docs_body` only re-reads `.md` refs, so config changes get neither diff nor read-back. `config/env-flags.json` is the AC-1 flag and is in the approved `review_scope.files`, so a future default-flip regression becomes invisible to the architect gate with no compensating evidence.

Same EXCLUDE change removes `**/docs/**` from the diff; defensible for docs because current content is re-read, but config has no equivalent substitute — the rationale comment covers only docs, leaving config exclusion unjustified and unreviewed.
MINOR: `backlog_write_guard.py`: the `# BI-PF-1399 demotion…` provenance comment was moved onto the new `backlog_db_export.py` line (producing two `#` comments on one line), so `backlog_rebuild_projections.py` loses its justification and the export entry carries a garbled comment in a security-guard file.

`_docs_body` is new gate logic with no test (guardrail 6: fail-able tests), and `ROOT / ref` accepts `..` refs — `affected_files` already contains `../.github/workflows/structure.yml`, so any `.md` ref can read outside ROOT.
[OUT_OF_SCOPE] `gen_docs_index.py` adds SPEC-CHAIN/FIX-IMPACT-CONTRACT entries unrelated to BI-PF-1531, and `main_test.go` is gofmt-only churn; both widen revert scope and muddy item traceability.
NIT: `_docs_body` magic limits (5000 chars/doc, 18000 total) are undocumented and the `sum(len(x) for x in out)` check is recomputed on every append.
The `backlog_db_export.py` allowlist justification ("uses derived projection helpers") is imprecise — it writes the projections that become authority after rollback, not merely derived helpers.
SUMMARY: Delta is largely tooling/formatting and does not itself break the five ACs; no blocker.

Top risk: `architect_review.py` silently widens its diff exclusion to `config/**` with no read-back substitute, permanently reducing review coverage for exactly the flag this item governs (`config/env-flags.json`) and conflicting with the approved review scope.
Secondary: comment/provenance corruption in the backlog write guard and untested new gate logic in `_docs_body`.
